description: A stereo sample player and recorder. It plays a selection out of the sample at a speed you set and tracks 1V per octave, and every audio file in the same directory as the loaded one is listed

params.text: Sets the playback speed, -2x to +2x, default 1x; a negative speed plays the selection backwards
Attenuates the voltage arriving at the FM input
Chooses the wave of the module's own LFO, between sine, triangle, saw and square
Sets the frequency of the module's own LFO, which can be pushed up to audio rate
Sets the depth of the modulation applied to the playback speed, both from the FM input and from the module's own LFO
Starts recording from the inputs, and stops it when tapped again
Switched on, the selection repeats; switched off, playback ends at the end of the selection
A tap starts playback from the beginning of the selection
A tap stops playback, and the next one carries on from where it stopped
Sets where in the sample the selection starts, which is where playback begins
Sets where in the sample the selection ends
Stretches the wave display vertically, and changes nothing about the sound
Sets a fade at the start and the end of playback to keep clicks out, from 0 to 100ms
Switched on, the sample plays only while the start gate is high and stops when it drops
How much of the voltage at the speed input reaches the playback speed

inputs.text: One side of the stereo signal to be recorded
A pulse starts recording from the inputs, and the next one stops it
A voltage added to the playback speed; at audio rate it becomes frequency modulation of the sample
A pitch voltage at 1V per octave, which plays the selection chromatically
A pulse starts playback from the beginning of the selection, and with GATED switched on a gate holds it
A pulse stops playback, and the next one carries on from where it stopped
A voltage moving the start point of the selection
A voltage moving the playback speed, through its own attenuator

outputs.text: One side of the stereo output
A pulse each time playback reaches the end of the selection

notes: the Simpler File Control expander steps through the list of audio files in the sample's directory, by pulse or by voltage
nothing plays until a sample is loaded; drop a wav or aiff file onto the module or load one from the menu
menu: MAX IMPORTABLE FILE SIZE — caps what can be loaded: Any file size, or Max 50, 20, 10, 5, 2 or 1 Mbytes
Speed CV input reducer — divides the voltage at the speed input before it is used: No reduction, Divide by 2, Divide by 5 or Divide by 10
Reset Playhead When Changing Sample — puts playback back to the start whenever a different file is picked
Open WAV or AIFF File... — loads a wav or aiff file as the sample

inputs.4: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
